abstract: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) was performed in 126 children with malignant solid tumor between April 1984 and December 1990. The criteria of tumor visualization, localization, staging, prediction of kidney preserving and monitoring treatment were compared by MRI and CT for 47 children with neuroblastoma, Wilms' tumor, hepatoblastoma, rhabdomyosarcoma and teratoma, MRI and CT were viewed together and an assessment was made as to whether the studies yielded equivalent information or whether one study was superior to the other. 1) The tumor were better visualized in 47% cases by MRI than CT. 2) MRI was superior to CT in 43% cases in evaluating the local spread of tumor. 3) There was little difference between MRI and CT in identification of lymph node metastases. 4) Without requiring the injection of intravenous contrast agents, MRI accurately defined displacement, invasion of renal vessels by neuroblastoma. MRI was excellent in prediction of kidney preserving. 5) MRI was useful to detect bone marrow metastases in neuroblastoma. The best imaging plane for a demonstration of bone marrow involvement was coronal in lower limbs.
abstract_ja: 小児悪性固形腫瘍の患児126例に対し、1984年4月から1990年12月の間に磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)を実施した。神経芽腫、Wilms腫瘍、肝芽腫、横紋筋肉腫、奇形腫の47例について、腫瘍の描出、局在、病期分類、腎温存の予測、治療経過観察の基準を、MRIとコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で比較した。両検査の画像を併せて読影し、同等の情報が得られるか、いずれかが優れているかを評価した。1) 腫瘍の描出はCTよりMRIで47%の症例で優れていた。2) 腫瘍の局所進展の評価はMRIがCTより43%の症例で優れていた。3) リンパ節転移の同定はMRIとCTでほとんど差がなかった。4) 静脈造影剤を要せず、MRIは神経芽腫による腎血管の偏位や浸潤を正確に描出し、腎温存の予測に優れていた。5) MRIは神経芽腫の骨髄転移の検出に有用だった。骨髄浸潤の描出に最適な撮像面は、下肢では冠状断であった。
